items.title: Digital Realty Trust (DLR) Stock Faces Q3 Earnings Valuation Reckoning
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust came into this Q3 2026 report with a rich 77.2x P/E and a stock that had risen over the past month, then the shares slipped 1.2% to about US$180 on the first trading day after results. That small pullback clashes with what the numbers actually show. Core funds from operations per share reached US$2.10 in the quarter and US$8.57 over the past year, and management lifted full year core FFO guidance.
